root_causes: bit_array_to_hex converts arbitrary digest bytes via UTF-8 and unwraps failed conversion to empty string. validate accepts empty expected hash in this case.
check_freshness only checks now-auth_date <= max_age and fails to bound future dates, negative now and negative policy.
Query parser silently discards missing '=' parts, accepts duplicates and falls back on invalid percent decoding.
required_fix: Byte-correct hex encoding, strict 64 lowercase or case-normalized hexadecimal hash and constant-time comparison.
Single authentication API binds signature, numeric identity and bounded freshness; explicit clock/max-age policy and future tolerance.
Bound query/token/user lengths, reject duplicate keys, malformed percent encoding, NUL/control ambiguities; application/x-www-form-urlencoded plus handling.
Independent standard HMAC golden vector passes; empty hash and malformed/duplicate fields refuse; boundary/future/expired cases.
Inspect HTTP integration; renderer alone has no auth and existing token_exchange only consumes alleged validated user.
